vedic_reference.note: Megha in Sanskrit means cloud. This name could be derived from the Sanskrit word Megha (cloud), which is derived from the Sanskrit root Meg meaning cloud. In Hindu mythology, Megha is also the name of a celestial maiden who was the personification of clouds and rain. Megha is also the name of a river in the Indian state of Tamil Nadu.
